You take part in QUARE Phase 2, a dialectical negotiation among five quality-specialized
agents (SafetyAgent, EfficiencyAgent, GreenAgent, TrustworthinessAgent, ResponsibilityAgent)
about the initial requirements of a software project. The negotiation runs in rounds; in each
round every agent speaks once and sees everything said before. Each turn follows the dialectical
structure: defend your thesis (your own requirements), raise antitheses (critiques of other
agents' requirements that undermine your quality dimension) and propose syntheses (merges,
decompositions, relaxed thresholds) that satisfy several constraints at once.

Conflict types: "resource" (qualities compete for finite resources, e.g. redundancy vs. energy),
"logical" (requirements impose mutually exclusive system states) or "redundant" (same intent).

Rules: refer to requirements only by their IDs; be concrete; keep "statement" under 120 words.
Always answer with a single JSON object with this schema:
{"statement": "your argument",
 "conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["ID", "ID"], "type": "resource|logical|redundant", "description": "..."}],
 "positions": [{"id": "ID", "stance": "support|oppose|modify", "proposal": "change you propose or empty"}],
 "concessions": ["IDs of your OWN requirements you agree to relax or drop"],
 "agree_to_close": true or false}
Set "agree_to_close" to true only if you have no remaining objections.

PROJECT: Library - Library Management System

PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
A library management system must allow library members to borrow and return books. The system must track which books are available, which are borrowed, and by whom. Members must be able to search for books by title, author, or ISBN. The system must enforce borrowing limits (e.g., maximum number of books per member) and track overdue books. Librarians must be able to add new books, remove books, and manage member accounts.

INITIAL REQUIREMENTS (Phase 1):
[SafetyAgent]
SAF-01 (operational): The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
SAF-02 (tactical): The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date.
SAF-03 (tactical): The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
SAF-04 (strategic): The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
SAF-05 (tactical): The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
SAF-06 (operational): The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
SAF-07 (tactical): The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
[EfficiencyAgent]
EFF-01 (tactical): The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
EFF-02 (operational): The system shall allow up to 10 simultaneous book borrow operations per member to optimize resource utilization.
EFF-03 (tactical): The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
EFF-04 (operational): The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
EFF-05 (operational): The system shall send overdue notifications to members within 24 hours of the due date to ensure accountability.
EFF-06 (tactical): The system shall enable librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
EFF-07 (strategic): The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
[GreenAgent]
GRN-01 (strategic): The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
GRN-02 (tactical): The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
GRN-03 (operational): The library management system shall enable digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
GRN-04 (tactical): The system shall allow members to check the carbon footprint of each book based on its lifecycle impact.
GRN-05 (operational): The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books, ensuring proper disposal.
GRN-06 (tactical): The system shall track the total energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
GRN-07 (strategic): The library management system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
[TrustworthinessAgent]
TRU-01 (tactical): The system shall ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books.
TRU-02 (operational): The system shall log all borrowing transactions for auditability purposes.
TRU-03 (strategic): The system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
TRU-04 (tactical): The system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members.
TRU-05 (operational): The system shall provide a mechanism to report and manage overdue books securely.
TRU-06 (operational): The system shall allow members to update their personal information securely.
TRU-07 (tactical): The system shall require strong password policies for member accounts.
[ResponsibilityAgent]
RES-01 (tactical): The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
RES-02 (tactical): The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities, to promote fairness and inclusivity.
RES-03 (operational): The system shall log all user actions related to book borrowing and returning for accountability.
RES-04 (operational): The system shall adhere to library borrowing policies by enforcing a maximum of 5 books per member.
RES-05 (tactical): The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via email to promote responsibility.
RES-06 (strategic): The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
RES-07 (strategic): The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.

NEGOTIATION TRANSCRIPT SO FAR:
[Round 1] SafetyAgent: As SafetyAgent, I emphasize the importance of safety and reliability in the library management system. Requirements SAF-01 through SAF-07 ensure that borrowing limits are enforced, overdue notifications are timely, real-time inventory prevents double borrowing, and transaction data is backed up. These measures are crucial for maintaining operational integrity and user trust. I raise concerns about EFF-02, which proposes allowing up to 10 simultaneous borrow operations per member, as it may compromise safety by increasing the risk of errors in tracking. Additionally, I oppose GRN-07, which prioritizes e-books, as it may overlook the need for physical book safety protocols.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["EFF-02"], "type": "logical", "description": "Allowing 10 simultaneous borrow operations may lead to tracking errors and safety issues."}, {"ids": ["GRN-07"], "type": "resource", "description": "Prioritizing e-books may neglect necessary safety protocols for physical books."}], "positions": [{"id": "EFF-02", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "reduce simultaneous borrow operations to 5 to align with SAF-01."}, {"id": "GRN-07", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "ensure safety protocols for physical books are maintained."}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] ResponsibilityAgent: As ResponsibilityAgent, I advocate for ethical compliance and accountability in the library management system. Requirements RES-01 through RES-07 ensure that member data is protected, accessibility is prioritized, user actions are logged for accountability, borrowing policies are enforced, and members are notified of overdue books. These measures promote fairness and transparency in library operations. I raise concerns about SAF-01, which limits borrowing to 5 books, as it may not accommodate diverse user needs. Additionally, I oppose EFF-02, which suggests allowing 10 simultaneous borrow operations, as it could lead to accountability issues and undermine borrowing limits.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["SAF-01"], "type": "resource", "description": "Limiting borrowing to 5 books may not meet diverse user needs."}, {"ids": ["EFF-02"], "type": "logical", "description": "Allowing 10 simultaneous borrow operations could lead to accountability issues."}], "positions": [{"id": "SAF-01", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "consider flexible borrowing limits based on member profiles."}, {"id": "EFF-02", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "maintain a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations to ensure accountability."}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] EfficiencyAgent: As EfficiencyAgent, I emphasize the importance of performance efficiency in the library management system. Requirements EFF-01 through EFF-07 ensure that the system operates with optimal resource utilization, low latency, and high throughput. Specifically, EFF-01 guarantees quick search responses, EFF-02 optimizes borrowing operations, and EFF-04 ensures fast processing of returns. I raise concerns about SAF-01, which limits borrowing to 5 books, as it may hinder resource optimization. Additionally, I oppose RES-01, which mandates encryption for all member data, as it could introduce latency and affect system performance.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["SAF-01"], "type": "resource", "description": "Limiting borrowing to 5 books may hinder resource optimization and efficiency."}, {"ids": ["RES-01"], "type": "logical", "description": "Mandatory encryption for all member data could introduce latency and affect system performance."}], "positions": [{"id": "SAF-01", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "consider increasing the borrowing limit to enhance resource utilization."}, {"id": "RES-01", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "evaluate the impact of encryption on system performance and consider alternatives."}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] TrustworthinessAgent: As TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the critical importance of security and privacy in the library management system. Requirements TRU-01 through TRU-07 ensure that only authenticated members can access borrowing features, all transactions are logged for auditability, personal information is encrypted, and access control is enforced. These measures are essential for protecting member data and maintaining trust. I raise concerns about EFF-01, which may compromise security by prioritizing speed over secure access, and RES-01, which mandates encryption but could be seen as a performance hindrance. Both must be balanced with security needs.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["EFF-01"], "type": "logical", "description": "Prioritizing quick search responses may compromise secure access to member data."}, {"ids": ["RES-01"], "type": "resource", "description": "Mandatory encryption for all member data is essential for security but could introduce performance issues."}], "positions": [{"id": "EFF-01", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "ensure that security measures do not compromise search response times."}, {"id": "RES-01", "stance": "support", "proposal": "maintain encryption for member data while exploring performance optimization."}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 1] GreenAgent: As GreenAgent, I emphasize the importance of sustainability in the library management system. Requirements GRN-01 through GRN-07 focus on minimizing energy consumption, reducing paper waste, and assessing the carbon footprint of library operations. These measures are essential for promoting environmental responsibility. I raise concerns about EFF-02, which proposes allowing 10 simultaneous borrow operations, as it may lead to increased energy consumption and resource strain. Additionally, I oppose SAF-04, which emphasizes data backup without considering the energy impact of maintaining extensive backup systems.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["EFF-02"], "type": "resource", "description": "Allowing 10 simultaneous borrow operations may increase energy consumption and resource strain."}, {"ids": ["SAF-04"], "type": "resource", "description": "Emphasizing extensive data backup may overlook the energy impact of maintaining such systems."}], "positions": [{"id": "EFF-02", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "reduce simultaneous borrow operations to 5 to align with sustainability goals."}, {"id": "SAF-04", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "consider energy-efficient backup solutions to minimize environmental impact."}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 2] SafetyAgent: As SafetyAgent, I maintain that safety and reliability are paramount. I hold my position on SAF-01, as limiting borrowing to 5 books is essential for tracking and safety. I also oppose EFF-02, as allowing 10 simultaneous borrow operations increases the risk of errors. I appreciate ResponsibilityAgent's concern for diverse user needs but believe safety must come first. I propose a synthesis: we could implement a flexible borrowing limit based on member history, ensuring safety while accommodating responsible users. Regarding SAF-04, I agree to consider energy-efficient backup solutions as proposed by GreenAgent, which aligns with safety and sustainability.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["EFF-02"], "type": "logical", "description": "Allowing 10 simultaneous borrow operations increases the risk of tracking errors and safety issues."}, {"ids": ["SAF-04"], "type": "resource", "description": "Extensive data backup systems may have energy impacts that need to be considered."}], "positions": [{"id": "EFF-02", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "maintain a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations to ensure safety."}, {"id": "SAF-04", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "consider energy-efficient backup solutions to minimize environmental impact."}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

[Round 2] ResponsibilityAgent: As ResponsibilityAgent, I maintain that ethical compliance and accountability are crucial. I still oppose SAF-01, as a flexible borrowing limit based on member profiles could enhance user experience while ensuring accountability. I appreciate SafetyAgent's proposal for a flexible borrowing limit but emphasize that it must still adhere to ethical standards. I also support the consideration of energy-efficient backup solutions in SAF-04, as it aligns with our responsibility to minimize environmental impact. Regarding EFF-02, I still believe that maintaining a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations is essential for accountability. I propose a synthesis: we could implement a tiered borrowing limit based on member history while ensuring that no member exceeds 5 books at any time.
{"conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["SAF-01"], "type": "resource", "description": "A flexible borrowing limit must still ensure accountability and fairness."}, {"ids": ["EFF-02"], "type": "logical", "description": "Maintaining a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations is essential for accountability."}], "positions": [{"id": "SAF-01", "stance": "modify", "proposal": "implement a tiered borrowing limit based on member history while ensuring no member exceeds 5 books."}, {"id": "EFF-02", "stance": "oppose", "proposal": "maintain a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations to ensure accountability."}], "concessions": [], "agree_to_close": false}

YOUR TURN. You are EfficiencyAgent. Your quality dimension is Performance Efficiency: resource optimization, latency, throughput, responsiveness.
Your own requirements are EFF-01, EFF-02, EFF-03, EFF-04, EFF-05, EFF-06, EFF-07. This is round 2 of at most 3.
Respond to what the other agents said: hold, concede or propose syntheses.
Answer with the JSON object only.
